messages.subject: akde() grid arguement
parts:
Hi,

I would like to calculate AKDEs for each of my individuals on the same grid with the purpose of using overlap(). When I try to enter lists into the akde() function it fails because I have too many individuals and it requires a lot of memory. To overcome this I need to specify the grid in akde() and calculate the UDs for each individual separately. 

Q. Is the grid parameter in akde() supported yet and if so can you help provide some guidance as how to define a grid for a list of telemetry objects that can be entered into akde()?

Best,
Jared

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: akde() grid arguement
parts:
Hi Jared,

The problem is almost certainly that the default grid is too large and dense. The first things I would try are

  1. Turning down the resolution argument. The default of res=10 is fairly high, but it needs to be >=1.
  2. Make sure that all individuals are near each other. I've had users report similar problems and it turned out that they had one tracked individual that was in a completely different area---making all default grids necessarily huge.

If that doesn't work, I would double loop over individuals and calculate overlaps for every pair.

Best,
Chris
